These relationships are supported by a combination of clinical indications and pharmacological connections, though the exact mechanism of action remains unclear. The presence of multiple pathways pointing to a common downstream effect—Ovarian Mucinous Adenocarcinoma—indicates a potential role for these compounds in the pathogenesis of the disease.
